faqs.q: What is the best golf course in Thailand?
faqs.a: Black Mountain Golf Club in Hua Hin is consistently ranked as Thailand's and one of Asia's finest layouts. It was named Thailand's number-one course by Golf Digest for multiple consecutive years and was the site of the Asian Tour's Thailand Classic. AGS places Black Mountain at the centre of all Hua Hin itineraries.

faqs.q: What are the best golf courses in Phuket?
faqs.a: Phuket's strongest trinity is Laguna Phuket Golf Club (Colin Montgomerie design, set within the resort precinct), Blue Canyon Country Club (Canyon Course — host of multiple Asian Tour events), and Red Mountain Golf Club (spectacular elevated terrain with rice paddy and mountain views). All three are available through AGS.

faqs.q: Which is better for golf — Phuket, Hua Hin, or Bangkok?
faqs.a: Each region serves different priorities. Bangkok has the most courses and the greatest variety. Hua Hin has the highest-ranked individual courses (Black Mountain, Pineapple Valley). Phuket offers the best combination of resort beach lifestyle and golf. AGS recommends combining two regions on a 7–10 day Thailand trip.

faqs.q: Is Chiang Mai worth visiting for golf?
faqs.a: Chiang Mai's highland courses — particularly Alpine Golf Club — offer spectacular highland scenery and consistent 18–24°C temperatures year-round. For golfers seeking something beyond resort golf, the Chiang Mai circuit is a compelling addition to a Bangkok or Hua Hin base.

faqs.q: How does Thailand golf compare to Vietnam for course quality?
faqs.a: At the very top tier, Thailand and Vietnam are comparable — Black Mountain and Hoiana Shores are peers in design quality. Thailand wins on course breadth and infrastructure maturity; Vietnam wins on cultural context and villa privacy. See our full Vietnam vs Thailand comparison guide for detail.

faqs.q: Have there been any new courses added in Thailand for 2026?
faqs.a: While the classic championship courses remain dominant, 2026 has seen major investments in course conditioning and clubhouse luxury across Phuket and Hua Hin.

faqs.q: Do these top 10 courses require a handicap certificate?
faqs.a: Most elite courses in Thailand prefer players to have a recognized handicap, though it is rarely strictly enforced unless you are playing in a formal tournament.

content:
Executive Summary:

  • Thailand's golf market, with over 300 courses across five regions (Bangkok, Hua Hin, Phuket, Pattaya, Chiang Mai), features Black Mountain Golf Club (Hua Hin, Schmidt-Curley, Par 72) as the top-ranked course for 2026, consistently holding Golf Digest Thailand's #1 position and hosting the Asian Tour's Thailand Classic.
  • Phuket's premier golf offerings include Blue Canyon Country Club (Canyon Course, Yoshikazu Kato, Par 72), which hosted four Thai Opens, and Laguna Phuket Golf Club (Colin Montgomerie redesign, Par 71), noted for its accessible luxury within the Laguna resort precinct.
  • Hua Hin boasts two top-tier courses designed by Schmidt-Curley: Black Mountain Golf Club and Pineapple Valley Golf Club (Par 72), with the latter often paired with Black Mountain for multi-day circuits due to its comparable conditioning and Gulf of Thailand views.
Related: Explore our Bangkok and Hua Hin Fairways luxury itinerary.

Thailand's golf infrastructure has been maturing for over three decades. With more than 300 courses distributed across five distinct regional circuits — Bangkok, Hua Hin, Phuket, Pattaya, and Chiang Mai — Thailand offers a breadth of golf travel that no other Southeast Asian country can match.

From our years of engineering Thai golf circuits for Australian clients, here are the 10 layouts that stand above the rest in 2026.

1. Black Mountain Golf Club

Location: Hua Hin | Designer: Schmidt-Curley | Par: 72 | Rating: ★★★★★

Thailand's finest course by consensus. Multiple Golf Digest Thailand #1 rankings. Host of the Asian Tour's Thailand Classic. Schmidt-Curley's design uses Hua Hin's Black Mountain backdrop and natural terrain changes to create risk-reward challenges throughout all 18 holes. An essential inclusion on any Thailand golf circuit.

2. Blue Canyon Country Club (Canyon Course)

Location: Phuket | Designer: Yoshikazu Kato | Par: 72 | Rating: ★★★★★

Phuket's most prestigious golf address. The Canyon Course hosted four Thai Opens and the 1998 Asian Tour's flagship event. Deep canyon hazards, lakeside holes, and immaculate conditioning make this a bucket-list Phuket experience.

3. Pineapple Valley golf club

Location: Hua Hin | Designer: Schmidt-Curley | Par: 72 | Rating: ★★★★★

Black Mountain's closest competitor in Hua Hin. Pineapple Valley's undulating terrain and elevated tee boxes create spectacular views of the Gulf of Thailand. Conditioning matches Black Mountain's high standard. Often paired with Black Mountain for a two-day Hua Hin circuit.

4. Laguna Phuket Golf Club

Location: Phuket | Designer: Colin Montgomerie (redesign) | Par: 71 | Rating: ★★★★☆

Set within the Laguna resort precinct, this Montgomerie redesign offers the most accessible luxury golf experience in Phuket. Water features, sea views from elevated holes, and the ability to walk back to your resort villa for lunch make it the ideal centrepiece for resort-focused golf trips.

5. Red Mountain Golf Club

Location: Phuket | Designer: Lee Schmidt / Brian Curley | Par: 72 | Rating: ★★★★☆

Built on a former tin mine, Red Mountain's rust-coloured terrain and dramatic elevation changes create the most visually distinctive golf in Phuket. The landscape views across rice paddies and mountain ridges are genuinely extraordinary from the elevated back nine tee boxes.

6–10: The Supporting Circuit

6. Siam Country Club (Old Course)

Pattaya's flagship — a classic Thai layout with mature trees and a long competitive history. Host of numerous Asian Tour events.

7. Springfield Royal Country Club (Hua Hin)

Jack Nicklaus design in Hua Hin — the third piece of the Hua Hin championship triple with Black Mountain and Pineapple Valley.

8. Alpine Golf Club (Chiang Mai)

Northern Thailand's premier highland layout. Consistently cool temperatures, spectacular mountain views, and a course that rewards accuracy in the valley approaches.

9. Thai Country Club (Bangkok)

One of Bangkok's most prestigious addresses — the home of the Honda LPGA Thailand for many years. Lush tropical fairways, water throughout, and excellent conditioning make this a strong Bangkok inclusion.

10. Nikanti Golf Club (Bangkok)

Bangkok's most striking modern design — an island-green course with dramatic water features and a private club feel. Host of the Thailand Mixed in recent years.

AGS engineers Thailand circuits around 3–5 of these courses depending on your itinerary duration and regional preference. Explore the Thailand golf hub or compare with our Vietnam top 10 to build the ideal dual-destination trip.
